answers.answer: The current-release endpoint reports stable release version 2.08, with stable_label "2.08-stable". The SCOPe 2.08 freeze date is 2021-07-28 and its release date is 2021-09-22. The latest periodic update is "2.08-2026-08-16", dated 2026-08-16. For a reproducible analysis, cite the stable release, SCOPe 2.08 ("2.08-stable"). It is a fixed, versioned snapshot of the classification, so the same domains, sccs strings and sunids can be re-checked later. If you used the periodic update, cite its dated identifier "2.08-2026-08-16" in addition, but not in place of the stable release. The periodic label means an interim, dated update layered on top of the 2.08 stable release. It picks up newly released PDB structures and incremental curation between stable releases. It is not a new stable release, and the underlying 2.08 classification is not re-frozen. The "latest" periodic update keeps moving, so "latest" or an undated reference is not reproducible. Assignments for newer entries may change or be added in later periodic updates, and these updates have had less review than a stable release. Cite the exact dated periodic identifier only if the analysis depends on content added after the stable release.
